text:
marta: APNE3 cluster warmup — ready to start GPU cluster warmup sequence. Can folks validate nodepools, CNI, and egress/NAT paths? I'll do the handoff to ops after smoke tests. :rocket:
ryan: On instance choice — planning A100 for perf. Quota shows A100 x8 available, starting with 2 nodes to validate perf/cost.
sophie: FYI cloud shows NAT gateway usage creeping up in apne3 (3/5). If we spin up multiple nodepools we should avoid creating per-pool NATs. Recommend reuse or request quota bump.
alex: Cost flag — A100 at full utilization will bump monthly costing ~32% for this region. Suggest autoscale with aggressive scale-down and node-termination grace.
jordan-oncall: Can someone paste the kubeadm join or nodepool manifest we'll use? I'll run through the validation checklist once I have the manifests. Also want kube-proxy and coredns pinned versions.
infra-bot: deployment-check: cluster-template-apne3 created (id: ct-09af). Control plane checks: healthy. CI job: https://ci.internal/redwood/ct-09af (logs available).
marta: Posting the quick validation snippets and commands to use (copy/paste):
```bash
# GKE style nodepool (example)
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-pool-1 \\  --cluster=apne3-ml-01 --machine-type=n1-standard-32 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=2 \\  --num-nodes=2 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=8 \\

# kubeadm join (if using kubeadm control plane)
kubeadm join 10.0.0.5:6443 --token <token> --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash sha256:<hash>

# validation commands
kubectl get nodes -l cloud-role=gpu -o wide
kubectl -n kube-system rollout status ds/nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset
```
sophie: When creating the nodepool, ensure taints and labels are set: `nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule` and `workload=ml`. Also enable node-local DNS cache for lower pod startup latencies.
ryan: Added the taint/label to the nodepool template. Also planning to helm install node-local-dns: `helm upgrade --install nodelocaldns ... --set image.tag=v1.17.0`
marta: Smoke tests to run after nodes are Ready (copyable):
```bash
# basic smoke check against internal inference endpoint
kubectl -n infra port-forward svc/inference-ml 8080:80 &
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || exit 1
# small load test (50qps for 60s)
hey -n 3000 -c 50 http://127.0.0.1:8080/predict?prompt=test
# verify GPU scheduling
kubectl get pods -l app=test-ml -o wide | grep gpu
```
alex: Created cost tracking ticket COST-OPS-784 and linked projected burn. We'll watch first 48h and then decide on reserved capacity or autoscale policy tweaks.
jordan-oncall: I'll start validation at 10:30 UTC. Plan: node readiness -> device-plugin -> network e2e -> latency smoke -> canary rollout. If NAT quota blocks provisioning, fallback plan is to attach to shared NAT via the subnet and mark tickets for quota increase.
marta: :thumbsup: I'll hold additional nodepool creation until NAT quota confirmed. Leaving this thread as the operative runbook for APNE3 warmup. @jordan-oncall please update status on completion or if you hit a blocker.
infra-bot: quota-snapshot: nat_gateways=3/5 in apne3 — recommended action: request quota increase or reuse existing NAT gateways.
marta: Acknowledged. I'll request quota bump and also publish the readme in Confluence with links to console, CI job, and cost ticket. Monitoring links: https://monitoring.internal/apne3 and https://ci.internal/redwood/ct-09af/logs
jordan-oncall: Noted — will post results here after run. If anything fails I'll open an incident thread and tag oncall.
